name: Provenance
rule: Every published number is read from a named official page this session, or is arithmetic on such numbers with the derivation shown in the same table.

name: No-lookahead
rule: A forecast for week w may only use games from weeks < w.
evidence_in_this_pack: walk_forward_design.csv; the fit is by construction earlier than the fixture

name: Sample
rule: A strategy needs >= 100 graded games before it can be ranked as qualified.

name: Calibration
rule: Mean predicted probability within 0.05 of the realised rate on the graded set.

name: Uncertainty
rule: Game-cluster bootstrap lower bound on skill must be above zero, i.i.d. and blocked.

name: Multiplicity
rule: Benjamini-Hochberg across every trial in the run at q = 0.10.

name: Controls
rule: Beat the no-skill constant and the seeded random control in the same division.

name: Price
rule: A stake, ROI or CLV number requires a licensed price source (policy PX-01).
evidence_in_this_pack: market_price_capture_log.csv - five attempts, all negative or not attempted

name: Combos
rule: A combo may be priced multiplicatively only when the joint outcome is measured on >= 100 fixtures and the interval on the difference from independence contains zero.

name: Rights
rule: No systematic retrieval published as a data feed; derived analysis only.

name: Immutability
rule: A capture that cannot be re-read with its hash and clock time cannot enter a backtest.

name: No-backtest-on-board
rule: The leaderboard may not display an in-sample number.
evidence_in_this_pack: the leaderboard is built from board['walk_rows'] only

name: Freshness
rule: A table whose source page has moved since its capture is stale and must be republished or blanked.
